name: InstaCo
shortDescription: Montana series-LLC management pearl — form, hold, operate entities end-to-end.
description: InstaCo is the company-formation and corporate-registry app of the Melusina estate: every grain is one Montana series-LLC — one series, one clan, one wallet, one team of bots, one inbox. The grain carries the entity end to end: formation, governance records, an OTP-gated approval flow, an append-only audit log, and payment handoff to a sibling ccash grain over raw Cap'n Proto. Six permission bits carry two role families — platform staff (Admin, Collaborator, Auditor) and the client side (Client, Client Assistant, Client View-Only) — and every console and API surface is gated by them.
